observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a stage with a white performance floor, in front of a seated audience and a live orchestra with harpsichord and transverse flute
observation.dancers: one man and one woman, mixed couple
observation.formation_and_space: partners dancing facing each other or side by side, traveling across the white stage area in patterns of approach and retreat
observation.posture: upright baroque posture with erect torso, soft knees, and feet turned out
observation.footwork: small baroque steps, demi-plies, heel-toe accents and sliding steps timed with the dotted rhythms of the music
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held rounded or extended gracefully at waist to side height, wrists soft with flowing motion
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and restrained, no isolated hip movements
observation.partnering: independent solo movements in close proximity, brief hand holds and passing turns without continuous physical contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low to medium level, no high jumps, graceful small turns and pivots
observation.costume_and_props: 18th-century style costume: man in long coat, breeches, hose and buckled shoes; woman in white blouse, dark bodice, long skirt and low-heeled shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot pressure, subtle weight shifts, and precise ornamentation details due to camera framing and stage distance

signature_moments.what: partners bow and begin side-by-side traveling steps with open arm carriage
parallel footwork travelling across the stage with extended arms pointing outward
light stepping with slight spring on the upbeat while passing one another
mirroring turns with graceful arm gestures moving in opposite directions
circling each other with light articulated steps and soft wrist movements
final symmetrical phrasing with extended arms and composed ending pose
